comparison.objective: Measure and operate a cutter to cut DIN rail to 250 mm; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Rail positioning plus lever or clamp/button operation versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer striking, and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: First cut within 1 mm with <0.5 mm rail motion versus four contact-driven notch fractures and retained inserts.
comparison.reason: Both invoke material separation, but the rail task chiefly tests measuring and machine operation; its simulation does not physically cut, while the candidate requires real contact-driven fracture and free fragments.
